name: app-research-insight-cards-with-gradient-orbs
title: Insight cards on black with blurred gradient orbs and a pale donut
whatItIs: A black slide with three large rounded cards in a horizontal carousel: a white card with a pale blue donut and a highlighted blue phrase, a cream card whose lower half glows orange, and a blue-gradient card peeking at the left. Small caps text says 'a collection of insights gathered from: User interviews'.
whatItMeans: Soft and reflective; blurred gradient orbs make qualitative research feel emotional.
techniques: Show insights as a carousel of cards that bleed off the edges.
Use a blurred coloured orb at the bottom of each card as a mood cue.
Colour one phrase in each headline with the card's accent.
Set cards on black so their colours are vivid.

vocabulary.definition: A card stating one research finding.
A blurred blob of colour used as decoration.
Cards cropped by the frame to imply more.
A highlighted phrase in a headline.
